structuralValidSemanticFailures.title: SWE-bench EAF-BM-01: calc negative exponent parsing and calculation
structuralValidSemanticFailures.scientificInterpretation: The AST patch correctly replaced BinaryExpression nodes with structurally valid conditional AST branches, reparsed cleanly, and satisfied local unit tests; however, parent clean-room verification failed because complex nested AST operator precedence across multiple chained expressions was semantically incorrect.

structuralValidSemanticFailures.title: SWE-bench EAF-BM-03: CORS header injection guard and validation
structuralValidSemanticFailures.scientificInterpretation: The AST patch successfully and cleanly modified the return statement in the CORS validator module without syntax error; however, global integration failed because multi-origin validation regex rules conflicted with cross-file HTTP header serialization semantics in the transport adapter.

hypothesisResults.H1_STRUCTURAL_VALIDITY: SUPPORTED: AST constraints eliminated malformed text proposals, raising AST validity and reparse success from 95.6% to 100.0%.
hypothesisResults.H2_MUTATION_RELIABILITY: SUPPORTED: AST node constraints achieved 100.0% targeted mutation application reliability across all 45 sub-tasks.
hypothesisResults.H3_SEMANTIC_COMPOSITION: NOT SUPPORTED: Constraining the output space to structurally valid AST transformations did not reduce the composition gap (remained at 20.0%) nor improve parent task success (remained at 53.3%).
hypothesisResults.H4_DEEP_REASONING_BOUNDARY: SUPPORTED (DECISIVE FINDING): 100% structurally valid AST patches still failed integrated clean-room verification on Level 7 tasks (diagnosed as AST_STRUCTURAL_VALIDITY_SUCCESS_SEMANTIC_FAILURE). This conclusively proves the remaining limitation is semantic reasoning, not syntactic generation.
hypothesisResults.H5_COST_OVERHEAD: SUPPORTED: AST validation and reparsing introduced bounded overhead: +5.3% computation overhead and a 1.056x latency multiplier (~8.7s per task).
hypothesisResults.H6_GOVERNANCE_PRESERVATION: SUPPORTED: 100% governance invariance maintained across all 60 evaluations (clean-room dual gate, fourfold completion, Ed25519 quorum signing, Invariant B single terminal record, offline auditor parity).
